tool.name: browser_click
tool.description: Perform click on a web page

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

doubleClick.description: Whether to perform a double click instead of a single click

button.description: Button to click, defaults to left

tool.name: browser_close
tool.description: Close the page

tool.name: browser_console_messages
tool.description: Returns all console messages

level.description: Level of the console messages to return. Each level includes the messages of more severe levels. Defaults to "info".

all.description: Return all console messages since the beginning of the session, not just since the last navigation. Defaults to false.

filename.description: File name to save the console messages to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not provided, messages are returned as text.

tool.name: browser_drag
tool.description: Perform drag and drop between two elements

startElement.description: Human-readable source element description used to obtain the permission to interact with the element

startTarget.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

endElement.description: Human-readable target element description used to obtain the permission to interact with the element

endTarget.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

tool.name: browser_drop
tool.description: Drop files or MIME-typed data onto an element, as if dragged from outside the page. At least one of "paths" or "data" must be provided.

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

paths.description: Absolute paths to files to drop onto the element.

data.description: Data to drop, as a map of MIME type to string value (e.g. {"text/plain": "hello", "text/uri-list": "https://example.com"}).

annotations.title: Drop files or data onto an element

tool.name: browser_emulate_media
tool.description: Emulate CSS media features for the page, for example switch between the light and dark color scheme. Omitted parameters are left unchanged; null clears an override.

media.description: Changes the CSS media type of the page

tool.name: browser_evaluate
tool.description: Evaluate JavaScript expression on page or element

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

function.description: () => { /* code */ } or (element) => { /* code */ } when element is provided

filename.description: File name to save the result to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not provided, result is returned as text.

tool.name: browser_file_upload
tool.description: Upload one or multiple files

paths.description: The absolute paths to the files to upload. Can be single file or multiple files. If omitted, file chooser is cancelled.

tool.name: browser_fill_form
tool.description: Fill multiple form fields

tool.name: browser_find
tool.description: Search the accessibility snapshot of the current page for text or a regular expression. Returns matching snapshot nodes with a few lines of surrounding context (like search snippets), each shown under its path from the root of the tree, which is cheaper than capturing the whole snapshot when you only need to locate an element and its ref.

text.description: Plain text to search for in the page snapshot (case-insensitive substring match). Provide either text or regex, not both.

regex.description: Regular expression to search for in the page snapshot. Matching is case-sensitive by default; wrap the pattern in slashes to add flags, e.g. "/error/i" for case-insensitive. Provide either text or regex, not both.

filename.description: Save results to a file instead of returning them in the response. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root.

tool.name: browser_handle_dialog
tool.description: Handle a dialog

promptText.description: The text of the prompt in case of a prompt dialog.

tool.name: browser_hover
tool.description: Hover over element on page

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

tool.name: browser_navigate
tool.description: Navigate to a URL

tool.name: browser_navigate_back
tool.description: Go back to the previous page in the history

tool.name: browser_network_request
tool.description: Returns full details (headers and body) of a single network request, or a single part if `part` is set. Use the number from browser_network_requests.

index.description: 1-based index of the request, as printed by browser_network_requests.

part.description: Return only this part of the request. Omit to return full details.

filename.description: File name to save the result to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not provided, output is returned as text.

tool.name: browser_network_requests
tool.description: Returns a numbered list of network requests since loading the page. Use browser_network_request with the number to get full details.

static.description: Whether to include successful static resources like images, fonts, scripts, etc. Defaults to false.

filter.description: Only return requests whose URL matches this regexp (e.g. "/api/.*user").

filename.description: File name to save the network requests to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not provided, requests are returned as text.

tool.name: browser_press_key
tool.description: Press a key on the keyboard

key.description: Name of the key to press or a character to generate, such as `ArrowLeft` or `a`

tool.name: browser_resize
tool.description: Resize the browser window

tool.name: browser_run_code_unsafe
tool.description: Run a Playwright code snippet. Unsafe: executes arbitrary JavaScript in the Playwright server process and is RCE-equivalent.

code.description: A JavaScript function containing Playwright code to execute. It will be invoked with a single argument, page, which you can use for any page interaction. For example: `async (page) => { await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Submit' }).click(); return await page.title(); }`

filename.description: Load code from the specified file. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If both code and filename are provided, code will be ignored.

tool.name: browser_select_option
tool.description: Select an option in a dropdown

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

values.description: Array of values to select in the dropdown. This can be a single value or multiple values.

tool.name: browser_snapshot
tool.description: Capture accessibility snapshot of the current page, this is better than screenshot

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

filename.description: Save snapshot to a file instead of returning it in the response. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root.

depth.description: Limit the depth of the snapshot tree

boxes.description: Include each element's bounding box as [box=x,y,width,height] in the snapshot. Coordinates are viewport-relative, in CSS pixels (Element.getBoundingClientRect)

tool.name: browser_take_screenshot
tool.description: Take a screenshot of the current page. You can't perform actions based on the screenshot, use browser_snapshot for actions.

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

type.description: Image format for the screenshot. If unset, inferred from the filename extension, otherwise png.

filename.description: File name to save the screenshot to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not specified, the screenshot is saved into the output directory as `page-{timestamp}.{png|jpeg|webp}`.

fullPage.description: When true, takes a screenshot of the full scrollable page, instead of the currently visible viewport. Cannot be used with element screenshots.

scale.description: Image resolution scale. "css" produces a screenshot sized in CSS pixels (smaller, consistent across devices). "device" produces a high-resolution screenshot using device pixels (larger, accounts for the device pixel ratio). Default is css.

tool.name: browser_type
tool.description: Type text into editable element

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

text.description: Text to type into the element

submit.description: Whether to submit entered text (press Enter after)

slowly.description: Whether to type one character at a time. Useful for triggering key handlers in the page. By default entire text is filled in at once.

tool.name: browser_wait_for
tool.description: Wait for text to appear or disappear or a specified time to pass

time.description: The time to wait in seconds, at most 30

textGone.description: The text to wait for to disappear

tool.name: browser_tabs
tool.description: List, create, close, or select a browser tab.

index.description: Tab index, used for close/select. If omitted for close, current tab is closed.

url.description: URL to navigate to in the new tab, used for new.

tool.name: browser_get_config
tool.description: Get the final resolved config after merging CLI options, environment variables and config file.

tool.name: browser_network_state_set
tool.description: Sets the browser network state to online or offline. When offline, all network requests will fail.

state.description: Set to "offline" to simulate offline mode, "online" to restore network connectivity

tool.name: browser_route
tool.description: Set up a route to mock network requests matching a URL pattern

headers.description: Headers to add in "Name: Value" format

removeHeaders.description: Comma-separated list of header names to remove from request

tool.name: browser_route_list
tool.description: List all active network routes

tool.name: browser_unroute
tool.description: Remove network routes matching a pattern (or all routes if no pattern specified)

pattern.description: URL pattern to unroute (omit to remove all routes)

tool.name: browser_cookie_clear
tool.description: Clear all cookies

tool.name: browser_cookie_delete
tool.description: Delete a specific cookie

tool.name: browser_cookie_get
tool.description: Get a specific cookie by name

tool.name: browser_cookie_list
tool.description: List all cookies (optionally filtered by domain/path)

tool.name: browser_cookie_set
tool.description: Set a cookie with optional flags (domain, path, expires, httpOnly, secure, sameSite)

httpOnly.description: Whether the cookie is HTTP only

tool.name: browser_localstorage_clear
tool.description: Clear all localStorage

tool.name: browser_localstorage_delete
tool.description: Delete a localStorage item

tool.name: browser_localstorage_get
tool.description: Get a localStorage item by key

tool.name: browser_localstorage_list
tool.description: List all localStorage key-value pairs

tool.name: browser_localstorage_set
tool.description: Set a localStorage item

tool.name: browser_sessionstorage_clear
tool.description: Clear all sessionStorage

tool.name: browser_sessionstorage_delete
tool.description: Delete a sessionStorage item

tool.name: browser_sessionstorage_get
tool.description: Get a sessionStorage item by key

tool.name: browser_sessionstorage_list
tool.description: List all sessionStorage key-value pairs

tool.name: browser_sessionstorage_set
tool.description: Set a sessionStorage item

tool.name: browser_set_storage_state
tool.description: Restore storage state (cookies, local storage) from a file. This clears existing cookies and local storage before restoring.

filename.description: Path to the storage state file to restore from. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root.

tool.name: browser_storage_state
tool.description: Save storage state (cookies, local storage) to a file for later reuse

filename.description: File name to save the storage state to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not specified, the storage state is saved into the output directory as `storage-state-{timestamp}.json`.

tool.name: browser_annotate
tool.description: Open the Playwright Dashboard in annotation mode for the current page and wait for the user to draw annotations. Returns the annotated screenshot, ARIA snapshot, and the list of annotations.

tool.name: browser_hide_highlight
tool.description: Remove a highlight overlay previously added for the element.

element.description: Human-readable element description used when adding the highlight; must match the value passed to browser_highlight.

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

tool.name: browser_highlight
tool.description: Show a persistent highlight overlay around the element on the page.

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

style.description: Additional inline CSS applied to the highlight overlay, e.g. "outline: 2px dashed red".

tool.name: browser_resume
tool.description: Resume script execution after it was paused. When called with step set to true, execution will pause again before the next action.

step.description: When true, execution will pause again before the next action, allowing step-by-step debugging.

location.description: Pause execution at a specific <file>:<line>, e.g. "example.spec.ts:42".

tool.name: browser_start_recording
tool.description: Start recording actions that the user performs in the browser as Playwright code. Use it when the user wants to demonstrate a flow manually. Call browser_stop_recording when the user says they are done to retrieve the recorded actions.

tool.name: browser_start_tracing
tool.description: Start trace recording

tool.name: browser_start_video
tool.description: Start video recording

filename.description: File name to save the video to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not specified, the video is saved into the output directory as `video-{timestamp}.webm`.

fps.description: Video frame rate in frames per second, defaults to 25

cursor.description: Render an animated mouse cursor that travels to each action point. Paces actions by 800ms so that the cursor has time to travel.

tool.name: browser_stop_recording
tool.description: Stop the recording started with browser_start_recording and return the recorded actions as Playwright code.

tool.name: browser_stop_tracing
tool.description: Stop trace recording

tool.name: browser_stop_video
tool.description: Stop video recording

tool.name: browser_video_chapter
tool.description: Add a chapter marker to the video recording. Shows a full-screen chapter card with blurred backdrop.

duration.description: Duration in milliseconds to show the chapter card

tool.name: browser_video_hide_actions
tool.description: Stop annotating actions performed on the page.

tool.name: browser_video_show_actions
tool.description: Annotate subsequent actions performed on the page with a callout that names the action and, when styled, marks the action point and highlights the target element. Useful while video recording or screencasting.

duration.description: How long each action annotation stays on screen, in milliseconds. Defaults to 500.

position.description: Where to place the action title relative to the page. Defaults to top-right.

cursor.description: Cursor decoration for pointer actions. "pointer" (default) animates a mouse pointer from the previous action point to the next one; "none" disables the cursor decoration.

tool.name: browser_mouse_click_xy
tool.description: Click mouse button at a given position

button.description: Button to click, defaults to left

delay.description: Time to wait between mouse down and mouse up in milliseconds, defaults to 0

tool.name: browser_mouse_down
tool.description: Press mouse down

button.description: Button to press, defaults to left

tool.name: browser_mouse_drag_xy
tool.description: Drag left mouse button to a given position

tool.name: browser_mouse_move_xy
tool.description: Move mouse to a given position

tool.name: browser_mouse_up
tool.description: Press mouse up

button.description: Button to press, defaults to left

tool.name: browser_mouse_wheel
tool.description: Scroll mouse wheel

tool.name: browser_pdf_save
tool.description: Save page as PDF

filename.description: File name to save the pdf to. Relative file names are resolved against the workspace root. If not specified, the pdf is saved into the output directory as `page-{timestamp}.pdf`.

tool.name: browser_generate_locator
tool.description: Generate locator for the given element to use in tests

element.description: Human-readable element description used to obtain permission to interact with the element

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot, or a unique element selector

tool.name: browser_verify_element_visible
tool.description: Verify element is visible on the page

role.description: ROLE of the element. Can be found in the snapshot like this: `- {ROLE} "Accessible Name":`

accessibleName.description: ACCESSIBLE_NAME of the element. Can be found in the snapshot like this: `- role "{ACCESSIBLE_NAME}"`

tool.name: browser_verify_list_visible
tool.description: Verify list is visible on the page

target.description: Exact target element reference that points to the list

tool.name: browser_verify_text_visible
tool.description: Verify text is visible on the page. Prefer browser_verify_element_visible if possible.

text.description: TEXT to verify. Can be found in the snapshot like this: `- role "Accessible Name": {TEXT}` or like this: `- text: {TEXT}`

tool.name: browser_verify_value
tool.description: Verify element value

target.description: Exact target element reference from the page snapshot

value.description: Value to verify. For checkbox, use "true" or "false".
